name: Loans
summary: Turns a loan enquiry into a document request, a register row and a chase in the business's own mailbox and spreadsheet. Crons read and draft; a person approves every email that leaves the business.

covered_by.enquiry-intake: intake (enquiries read from the Outlook folder)
covered_by.collect-documents: draft (document request email drafted, queued for approval)
covered_by.lender-submission: not covered (lodgement is done in each lender's portal)
covered_by.compliance-record-keeping: draft (register row in the loan register)

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: New loan enquiries from the enquiries mailbox folder.

crons.name: draft
crons.summary: Add each new enquiry to the loan register, draft the document request, queue its send for approval.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: a read of the enquiries folder, an Outlook draft, a row in the loan register. Sending a draft to a client is a live operation and waits for a person.

microsoft-365.covers: enquiries from an Outlook folder, document request as an Outlook draft, loan register as an Excel table

gaps: BrokerEngine, Mercury Nexus and SalesTrekker have docs but no mapped operations in the kit, so none is built. Their steps stay manual or skill-driven.
Serviceability, credit checks, lender selection and lender lodgement have no mapped operation. The agent does these as judgment, or the broker does them in the lender portal.
Approval and decline letters, settlement tasks and the chase of outstanding documents need the platform's status, which is not built. Only the first document request is drafted.
HubSpot and Zoho are in the kit but are not mapped for loan steps, so they are not built. Add them when a client names the CRM they use.
The adapter is docs-only until a Microsoft 365 developer tenant proves it. Field names were checked against the Microsoft Graph spec in endpoint-map/raw/microsoft-365.
